# Gateway — LLM Discovery Index

## Overview
Gateway is a backtesting and demo-trading workspace for algorithmic strategies and trading bots. All trading is simulated: no broker is contacted, no order is routed, and no real capital is involved. Requirements are defined in `docs/SRS.md`.

## Sections (all at /docs/)
- SRS — unified requirements (functional, quantitative, non-functional, phases P1–P6)
- Deployment — Cloudflare Pages, API container, Supabase
- Archive — superseded phase plans, kept for history only

## Key References
- `docs/SRS.md` — the single source of truth
- `docs/deployment.md` — hosting and environment configuration

## Artifacts
- /llms.txt (this file)
- /sitemap.xml (crawl map)
- /robots.txt (crawlers allowed /docs/)
